name: Billdu
summary: Billdu is an invoicing app with no free plan and a 7-day trial that needs no card. Plans start at an average $4.99 a month on annual billing for 10 clients, and a Pay button on online invoices runs on Stripe and PayPal.

facts.text: Billdu shows whether an invoice is paid, due or overdue, and says it updates the status automatically after sending.
Billdu says it is powered by Stripe and PayPal, and the Pay button accepts credit cards, debit cards and PayPal.
Billdu publishes no payment fee rates on the page we read and says fees vary by payment method and location.
The pricing page footnote says displayed prices are average monthly prices when buying an annual subscription.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: Average monthly price on annual billing. 10 clients, 1 team member, unlimited invoices, no estimates

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Average monthly price on annual billing. 50 clients, up to 2 team members, payment reminders

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Average monthly price on annual billing. Unlimited clients, up to 10 team members, recurring invoices and API

hiddenCosts: The page also shows higher figures of $7.99, $14.99 and $27.99 without labeling them; they are probably monthly billing prices.
Payment processing fees by Stripe and PayPal are charged per transaction and are not listed in rates.
